**What you would like**
A clear description of the feature or experiment.

**Why it matters**
What question would it answer, or what would it make possible?

**Compute cost, if you know it**
This project targets a single 8 GB GPU. If your suggestion needs more than
that, please say so — it may still be worth documenting even if we cannot run it.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about.
